injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

reasoning: On the season so far the Suns are the stronger team; with home court the Suns start about 4 points better, in a game of about 229 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Suns.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Suns win 66 times in 100, by about 5; most games like this end between 203 and 252 total points.
